do.say: When I was a girl, the Wick burned so bright you could read by it at the foot of this hill.
Now look at it. I pray for it to burn a little longer. Just until I'm gone. That's selfish, isn't it?
It started with the candles. They sweated, even cold. Then the pilgrims did.
The Order says it's penance. The Order says a lot of things, from very high up.

then.say: Something changed up there. The shrine is warmer. Bless you, whoever you are.

else.say: I'll pray for you too. It's no trouble. I'm here anyway.
